question: Simplify 3(((7)/(3))x²-26x+13)-7(x²+9x-11)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Calculate the resulting terms directly by expanding and grouping the coefficients of identical variables.

x² term: 3 × (7/3) − 7 × 1 = 7 − 7 = 0

x term: 3 × (−26) − 7 × 9 = −78 − 63 = −141x

Constant term: 3 × 13 − 7 × (−11) = 39 + 77 = +116

Combining all the terms, we get −141x + 116.

**∴ The correct answer is −141x + 116.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

3((7/3)x² − 26x + 13) − 7(x² + 9x − 11)

**Formula Used:**

Distributive Property: a(b + c) = ab + ac

**Calculations:**

Expanding the brackets by multiplying the outer constants with each term inside:

⇒ 3 × (7/3)x² − 3 × 26x + 3 × 13 − 7 × x² − 7 × 9x − 7 × (−11)

⇒ 7x² − 78x + 39 − 7x² − 63x + 77

Grouping the similar terms together:

⇒ (7x² − 7x²) + (−78x − 63x) + (39 + 77)

⇒ 0x² − 141x + 116

⇒ −141x + 116

**∴ The correct answer is −141x + 116.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Distributive Property

It states that multiplying a sum by a number gives the same result as multiplying each individual term by the number and then combining the products: a(b − c) = ab − ac.

BODMAS Rule

It is a sequence used to perform mathematical operations accurately: Brackets, Orders (powers/roots), Division, Multiplication, Addition, Subtraction.

Like Terms

When adding or subtracting algebraic expressions, only like terms (terms with identical variables and identical powers) can be combined or reduced.
